services.desc: The Dramatic Arts Department & Connecticut Repertory Theatre manages two vehicles for the School of Fine Arts. To make a reservation, submit the Vehicle Rental Request Form Anyone interested in renting our vehicle must fill out the Driver Agreement Form and attach it to the Vehicle Rental Request Form. All vehicle rentals will be charged for gas & mileage reimbursements. Please allow for up to 7 days to process your request. The Dramatic Arts will charge $30 rental fee per day plus an additional $.625 per mile for gas reimbursement. Any on Storrs Campus Travel (which includes to Kirby Mill or the Depot Campus) will be charged the rate of $15 per day plus an additional $.625 per mile for gas
